description: Provisions a managed Qdrant vector database on a dedicated VM. Requires a recent plan_managed_datastore (engine 'qdrant'). Reachable from your private network at <private_ip>:6333 (REST) and :6334 (gRPC), and at a public https URL; every request must carry the api-key header (always required). Backups: set_managed_backups with service 'qdrant'. FOR AN APP YOU DEPLOY YOU DO NOT NEED THIS: report vector_engines:['qdrant'] in send_signals and the deploy starts and wires a managed Qdrant itself (a compose stack's own qdrant service is replaced by it). Provisioning takes a few minutes; poll list_qdrant until status='ready'.

api_key.description: The API key every request must send (the api-key header). Auto-generated and returned once if omitted. A managed Qdrant always requires one.

flavor_id.description: Instance size, from plan_managed_datastore/list_flavors. m1.small (2GB) holds most collections; vectors live in RAM, so size up for millions of large vectors.

keypair_name.description: SSH keypair name, from list_keypairs (for operating the Qdrant VM).

name.description: Name for the managed Qdrant (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens).

network_id.description: Private network id, from list_private_networks (or check_deploy_prerequisites). Use the SAME network as the app that will connect.

name: create_qdrant
title: Create managed Qdrant (vector database)
